plans.idea: Classic landscape split: a left-aligned column (logo, big two-line headline, CTA, legal) sharing one left edge, with the bottle filling the right half so the eye reads brand, message, then action next to the product.
Product first: the bottle leads on the left and the right column stacks logo, headline and CTA on one shared left edge, so the copy ends right where the eye leaves the product.

Keep the original's left-to-right banner order (logo, bottle, CTA) as a band under a wide one-line headline across the top, so the layout reads like a 16:9 version of the source rather than a re-stacked column.
